# How I Think — Six-Beat Storyboard

**Format:** one 16-second continuous 16:9 clip; flat pure-white background; no backdrop shading, gradients, vignettes, borders, or cast shadows on the background. Only faint, soft contact shadows directly beneath Shruti and floating interface objects so they sit naturally on the white stage. No embedded text; crisp captions are rendered by the page.

| Time | Narration / caption | Continuous visual action |
|---|---|---|
| 0:00–0:02.4 | **LOOK** | Shruti, matching the supplied avatar reference, lifts an oversized magnifying glass and leans in to inspect one small abstract visual card. Hold long enough to read the caption. |
| 0:02.4–0:04.7 | **QUESTION** | A single large question mark drops gently into the white space above her. Her eyes track it; she lowers the magnifier and shifts into a thoughtful, curious expression. |
| 0:04.7–0:07.1 | **UNDERSTAND** | She turns the visual card over and lifts one simple surface layer, discovering a few neatly arranged details beneath it. Her expression reads attentive insight, not surprise. |
| 0:07.1–0:09.4 | **MAKE** | She places a few clean interface pieces together into one simple, abstract screen. Keep all geometry minimal and free of legible words or logos. |
| 0:09.4–0:11.8 | **TEST** | She taps one clear control; it catches briefly. She notices, adjusts the control, then tries again successfully. Small, natural hand movement. |
| 0:11.8–0:16.0 | **LEARN** | She notes a small takeaway on a card, looks at the improved interface, and gives a warm, quietly pleased smile. Settle into a composed final pose with visual breathing room for the beige career-line transition. |

**Continuity:** preserve the same face, warm brown curls, dark jacket, floral top, light trousers, camera, lighting, scale, and polished 3D illustration style. Keep her centered at a consistent size with a camera-locked view and smooth connected body movement. Maintain a plain white field through the full clip. No scene cuts, flickering stills, typography, watermarks, decorative background props, ambient shadows, or changes to character design.

**Post-clip end slate:** On the site’s beige/terracotta palette, show “Somewhere along the way, I found my way of figuring things out.”; the line LOOK → QUESTION → UNDERSTAND → MAKE → TEST → LEARN; and the handwritten aside “rarely this neat, btw.” Transform the line into NIFT → SANT RAM’S → JANITRI → NOW → ?. Shruti reaches toward the question mark and looks to the visitor. Resolve to “room for one more…”, “Maybe your team goes here?” and one “LET’S WORK TOGETHER ↗” CTA. Keep Dive deeper as a separate project path.
